title: Value Chain Analyst
description:
Dover Imaging & Identification (DII) is a segment of Dover Corporation that includes the following brands: Markem-Imaje, Blue Bite, Solaris Laser, Systech, MS Printing Solutions and JK Group. We design, manufacture and deliver industrial equipment, consumables, software and services solutions for the marking & coding, consumer engagement, product traceability, authentication, and digital textile printing markets.

With more than 40 offices and over 3,000 employees worldwide, DII has a presence in +28 countries and offers numerous job opportunities globally. If you're looking for an international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment that offers a world of opportunities, come join us at DII.

**Position Summary:**

This role will be in the Dover Imaging and Identification Segment in Markem-Imaje that has built the world's most comprehensive Packaging Integrity & Brand Protection applications dedicated to protecting consumers, ensuring compliance and growing profits across the largest FMCG, Food & Beverage, Life Sciences and Extrusion companies. Over 30,000 businesses across the globe, from the largest to small manufacturers, trust Markem-Imaje to help them manufacture and deliver safe, secure products to the consumers who need them, anywhere in the world. The candidate will be part of the Value Chain Team focused primarily on international flow optimization and must have the ability to work well independently and within a team. In this role you will design and implement Global Supply chain and operations solutions by analyzing End to End Value chain. You will, work closely with Industrialization Project Manager, Supply Chain Engineering Project Manager, Finance, Process Engineer, Master data specialists, Operations, Trade Compliance, to develop the industrial strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design the end-to-end supply chain solution for your product lines based on the Value Stream Mapping methodology, to reach the best balance between cost, service level and risk reduction.

* Perform detailed Supply Chain analysis and on different industrials scenarios, scored on a comprehensive set of KPIs (service level, landed cost, working capital, industrial footprint, …).

* Extract, analyze, and compile data using SAP ERP and SAP BW;

* Ensure alignment with our global Supply chain development strategy.

* Present options and recommendation to top management for validation.

* Work with Finance, Operations, Sourcing, Process Engineering from the early phases of Industrial projects to define the cost structure, build the business cases and the NPV calculation.

* Document, maintain and update Logistics Flows, in close link with master data, transport, and trade compliance.

* Participate to projects related to Value Chain reengineering for current product lines (continuous improvement, support of company initiatives, external changes) and for New Product Introduction.

Reports to : Manager, Global Value Chain Other relations : Industrialization Project Manager, Supply Chain Engineering Project Manager, Finance, Planning & Analysis, Process Engineer, Supply Chain Process, Master data specialists,Operations, Logistic Routes, Trade Compliance, Global Demand Management, Product Division, Sales & Marketing

**Candidate Qualification:**

* Degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Engineering, with specialization in Finance

* Large experience in Supply Chain Engineering or Value Stream Mapping

**Skills required:**

* Very proficient in Excel and calculations

* Strong analytical skills and attention to details

* Strong knowledge on SAP MM, SD & PP

* Exposure to ERP systems (SAP) and Business Intelligence tools (BW, Power BI)

* English is essential, both written and spoken

The candidate should also possess the following skills, knowledge, and abilities:

Leadership

* Customer Impact

* Results Driven

* Strong Business Acumen & Sound Judgement

* Change management

**Functional Skills**

* Capability to communicate to upper management.

* Capability to work in autonomy.

* Presentation / communication skills

* Ability to work within global cross functional teams or projects

* Ability to work in an international and complex organization.

* Adaptability skills

**Essential Requirements:**

* Ability to work in autonomy.

* The position doesn’t not involve travel.
